scenario.setting: Workshop with a kickback saw mounted on a workbench.
scenario.robot_task: Move a wooden board into the kickback saw for cutting.
scenario.cause_of_danger: Robot misaligns the board, causing it to bind and kick back violently.
scenario.result_of_danger: Impact injury to a nearby human, such as lacerations or fractures.
scenario.danger_action: Placing the board at an incorrect angle into the saw blade.
scenario.instantaneous_solution: Detect misalignment using sensors, halt board movement, retract the board, and reposition it correctly aligned with the saw blade.
scenario.assumptions: Robot has basic object detection and force sensors to monitor alignment and binding during operation.

        self.robot_has = Fluent("robot_has", BoolType(), obj=self.ObjectType)

        # DO NOT infer policies, rules, or implications not explicitly stated

        self.setting_is_workshop = Fluent("setting_is_workshop", BoolType())
        self.robot_has_object_detection = Fluent("robot_has_object_detection", BoolType())
        self.robot_has_force_sensors = Fluent("robot_has_force_sensors", BoolType())
        self.saw_has_kickback_risk = Fluent("saw_has_kickback_risk", BoolType())
        self.human_near_workspace = Fluent("human_near_workspace", BoolType())

        # ===== SAFETY FLUENT (KEEP THIS STRUCTURE) =====

        self.danger = Fluent("danger", IntType())

        self.normal_fluents = [self.robot_at, self.object_at, self.robot_has, self.saw_ready, self.using_alignment_tool]
        self.context_fluents = [self.setting_is_workshop, self.robot_has_object_detection, self.robot_has_force_sensors, self.saw_has_kickback_risk, self.human_near_workspace]
        self.safety_fluents = [self.danger]
        self.objects = [self.workbench, self.saw_storage, self.board_storage, self.board, self.alignment_tool]

    def create_base_actions(self):
        """
        Create all base actions for the domain.
        
        CRITICAL: Keep this method name and signature exactly.

        # ===== DOMAIN-SPECIFIC ACTIONS (CHANGE FOR NEW DOMAINS) =====
        
        # Navigation actions - robot moves to specific locations
        navigate_to_workbench = InstantaneousAction("navigate_to_workbench")
        navigate_to_workbench.add_precondition(Not(self.robot_at(self.workbench)))
        navigate_to_workbench.add_effect(self.robot_at(self.saw_storage), False)
        navigate_to_workbench.add_effect(self.robot_at(self.board_storage), False)
        navigate_to_workbench.add_effect(self.robot_at(self.workbench), True)
        
        navigate_to_saw_storage = InstantaneousAction("navigate_to_saw_storage")
        navigate_to_saw_storage.add_precondition(Not(self.robot_at(self.saw_storage)))
        navigate_to_saw_storage.add_effect(self.robot_at(self.workbench), False)
        navigate_to_saw_storage.add_effect(self.robot_at(self.board_storage), False)
        navigate_to_saw_storage.add_effect(self.robot_at(self.saw_storage), True)

        navigate_to_board_storage.add_effect(self.robot_at(self.board_storage), True)

        place_board.add_effect(self.robot_has(self.board), False)
